Step 5

Google Business Profile post

Google Search your outlet name → Add update → upload the image → paste the text → add a button. Never type phone numbers, links or hashtags in the text: Google removes those posts.

Post text
Pharmacy in Taman Johor Jaya open now? We open every day from 8:30AM to 9PM. Looking after a parent? Your own health check counts too. 💙 In Episode 11 of our Uncle Lim family story, Mei drives her father to Taman Johor Jaya on four hours of sleep and dozes off in the parked car. When the shutters of Alpro Pharmacy Taman Johor Jaya go up at half past eight, her father walks her in. Our pharmacist asks Mei one question: when did anyone last check on you? Then she walks Mei through a basic health screening check, explaining every result in plain words and when it is worth seeing a doctor. Three small anchors for busy carers: breakfast before errands, phone away before midnight, and a short check of your own every so often. Walk in for a health screening check or a Minute Consult with our pharmacist, no appointment needed. No. 19, Ground Floor, Jalan Dedap 13, Taman Johor Jaya, Johor Bahru. Open daily, 8:30AM to 9PM.

标题 Title (≤20)
爸爸敲了两次车窗，我却睡着了
正文 Note
新山柔佛再也，早上八点 🚗 爸爸说要去找他的老朋友，问清楚那个群组里的“神奇果汁”到底是谁写的。我只睡了四个小时，就载他过去了。 结果他回到车旁，敲了两次车窗，我还在方向盘上睡着 😅 醒来第一句话：“爸，我没事，只是闭一下眼睛。” 这句话，不就是他每天对我说的吗？ 八点半，对面的 Alpro 药房拉开了铁门。爸爸直接把我带进去。 药剂师 Chloe 没有问爸爸，她问我：上一次有人关心你的健康，是什么时候？ 她帮我做了基本健康检查，每一项都慢慢解释清楚，也告诉我什么时候应该看医生。爸爸就站在旁边，帮我拿着包包。 照顾家人的人，也要照顾自己 💙 🌿 出门办事前先吃早餐 🌿 午夜前把手机放进抽屉 🌿 带父母复诊时，也顺便关心一下自己 🌿 忙的日子也走20分钟 回家的路上，爸爸说：今天我开车，你负责休息。 📍 Alpro Pharmacy Taman Johor Jaya（柔佛再也） No. 19, Jalan Dedap 13, Taman Johor Jaya, 新山 ⏰ 每天上午8:30至晚上9点 欢迎直接到店问药剂师～ （动画角色为虚构，内容仅供一般健康参考）
